why: In a versus world every tank is player-kind, so the campaign predicate `isTargetable` accepts the subject itself and, in teams, its own team-mates. Dropping to a bare liveness check is the shape that mistake takes. #891's criterion 'a bot never targets itself, and team mode never targets a team-mate' is what this pins.
killedBy: who a bot may fight (issue #891) never targets itself in ffa
who a bot may fight (issue #891) never targets a team-mate in teams, and takes the further enemy over the nearer friend
